overview.Module Title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technologies for Language Education

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This course integrates teaching theories, practices and research in the field of AI for language education. The main aims of the module are: • To acquaint students with fundamental concepts, principles, research and theories of using Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in language teaching and learning • To develop an awareness of innovation in the use of emerging AI in language teaching and learning • To develop students’ skills and advanced knowledge to use a range of AI technologies in language teaching and assessment •To develop students’ skills in critical evaluation of the potential and AI application in practice
sections.Learning outcomes: Upon completion of this module, students should be able to: A. Demonstrate understanding of the impact of Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies on language education B. Demonstrate understanding of technology theoretical approaches, materials and tools C. Create practical tasks and learning activities in using a range of AI tools for language teaching D. Critically analyze and discuss research into AI technology and language teaching and learning
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and tutorials/seminars.
